items.t: Barrick’s CEO meets Mali’s PM for first time since resolution
items.sum: Investing.com -- The chief executive of Barrick Mining's new international division met with Mali's prime minister on Wednesday, marking the first visit by a foreign company executive since the two sides resolved a major dispute a year ago.

items.t: Bullish Signals Appear Across The Precious Metals Sector
items.sum: There were prominent reversal candles across the metals sector on Wednesday after metals prices dropped to silly oversold extremes at trendline targets.

items.t: What To Expect From November 2026's Job Report
items.sum: Markets put December Fed hike odds at 98.1% after core PCE rose to 3.3%; a severe November jobs decline could avert the 25-basis-point move.

items.t: Stanley Druckenmiller and 10 Other Big Funds Bought Newmont Last Quarter. Ken Fisher and 5 Others Sold. Who’s Right?
items.sum: Key TakeawaysOf the 460 big funds that have filed 13Fs for the third quarter, 11 bought Newmont and 6 sold, with Stanley Druckenmiller’s Duquesne Family Office opening new stakes in Newmont, Agnico Eagle and Barrick. Most of the sellers trimmed.
